_doc: Explicit single-source-of-truth coverage registry. Each entry pins a canonical source file to the guard (contract test or verifier) that FAILS when a duplicate/circumvention drifts from it. canonical_coverage.py asserts every source+guard exists and every guard references its source via `marker`, so a canonical source can never silently lose its drift gate. This file is itself an entry (fixed point): its guard is the canonical_source_coverage contract test.

sources.why: Single self-origin/observation classifier; live consumers + bash _self_tags.sh must not re-declare local SELF_TAG_RE subsets.
Single model-family classifier; no raw /opus|sonnet|haiku/ regex/includes may live outside it.
Service registry; start/fix command paths must resolve on disk.
State-file ownership registry; owner/reader/writer/repair command paths must resolve on disk.
Event-kernel route registry; declared hook scripts must exist and switch/contract must agree.
Middleware manifest; every module's phase/effects/strictMode/idempotency metadata is validated against load order.
Single input-shortcut source for both the proxy (wire lanes) and the PTY bridge (multi-step).
Canonical internal-name to user-facing-form map; retired wrappers stay gone.
Telemetry event registry; the doc block is generated from it and live emitters may only use registered names.
SSE response rewriter pipeline; strategy ordering is pinned so a reorder is a test failure.
This registry itself (fixed point): the coverage lattice must gate its own input registry.
